scope: Legion outdoor world quest refresh after publication and three missing rotation candidates
causes: The rotation published active tasks and area bindings. A player already standing in that area did not enter the native task admission path until a movement/group/reward update.
The live world_quest_update table contained no entries for 46021, 46063 or 46073.

Other rotating tasks can replace the client's state 13114 or suppress the objective phase for an active Wailing Dead or Break Their Garrison. The live phase rows provided the conflicting alternatives.

evidence.client_data: The matching Legion 7.3.5 QuestV2CliTask, WorldStateExpression, AreaGroupMember and PlayerCondition records were read through the native DB2 reader. Local EventObject spawns 219, 230 and 232, phase definitions 7541/141 and 7543/126,142, and objective spawns were checked against them.
evidence.timer_policy: Inherited the realm's existing 6-hour Stormheim assault and 24-hour Broken Shore patterns. These are server policy durations and are not a verification of original Blizzard timer lengths. VerifiedBuild is 0 for the reconstructed rotation rows.
evidence.reference_context: Local TrinityCore history corroborated objective IDs. The March 2017 Break Their Garrison video description (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8InVRLd7_I8) was available for context; footage was not used or claimed as verified. No external duration or state was used.

implementation.publication: Collect newly registered area bindings in the world-thread batch. Schedule map-thread player callbacks; those recheck the applicable location and call the same native world-task admission used on normal area updates. The callback adds no bonus task or objective progress.
implementation.eligibility: Native account achievement 11473 and the assault wrapper protect 46021. The Broken Shore tasks retain the original 41694/46734, task-level and aura rules. Local quest logs and expiration remain native.
implementation.exclusion: State 13114=2 excludes Creepy Crawlies (13114=3) and the lich variant (13071), whose phase hides Wailing Dead objectives. State 12978=3 excludes Felskorn state 12979. Automatic and manual activation preserve the current variant until it is removed. Existing Helarjar admission and manual semantics are retained.
implementation.migration: Replay-safe insert for the three missing candidates. Existing operator rows are preserved.

checks.native: Temporary MariaDB rotation and conditions fixtures, initialized native loaders and actual EventObject positions, populated world state manager, unchanged player position, existing queue and player admission, actual native personal Conversation and matching quest phase. Thel'draz also had to request recalculation from the native delayed acceptance callback. Tested unqualified players, an expired queued offer, repeat admission and state exclusions in both orders. No persistent CharacterDatabase rotations were generated by the probe.
checks.retained: 1,458 client task prerequisite expression cases, 27 area/controller cases, 165 area dialogue cases and both retained Helarjar native source-derived suites. The Helarjar prerequisite fixture rejects any unexpected additional requirement and the exact original failing state-conflict baseline still reproduces.
checks.pe: Staged and canonical PE verifiers follow publication, ordinary admission, shared state exclusion, previous area intro and canonical Scepter call paths through the matching final-link inputs.

deployment.readback: MariaDB returned exactly the three tested rows and updater state RELEASED after deployment.
deployment.diagnostics: Task-owned canonical worldserver PID 23800 reached ready and exited 0 by server shutdown 0. Stderr was empty. No new crash, DBErrors, unexplained warning, error or assertion. Canonical Crashes is empty and DBErrors.log is 0 bytes.

evidence_and_cleanup.post_cleanup: Evidence, Release files and rollback hashes verified after removing staged executables, temporary runtimes and generated test builds. Canonical diagnostics still empty and no task-owned server or probe remains.

open: Actual online timer rollover, offer UI, voice/avatar playback and complete client kills/reward traversal are separate from native fixture verification.
The optional Wailing Dead and Garrison target presentations remain outside this focused rotation repair. Only authored actor phases and local objective spawn evidence were checked.
